description: This file contains unit tests for the 'cordz' feature of the Abseil C++ library, specifically testing the behavior of the 'Cord' class and its internal 'cordz' tracking mechanisms, including construction, assignment, modification, and subcord operations.

classes.name: CordzUpdateTest
classes.description: A parameterized test fixture for testing updates to the Cord class with various sizes.

classes.name: CordzStringTest
classes.description: A parameterized test fixture for testing string operations on Cord with various sizes.

methods.name: PrintTo
methods.description: Prints a Cord object to an output stream, showing its size.

methods.name: MakeString
methods.description: Creates a string_view of a specified size filled with '.' characters.

methods.name: MakeAppendStringCord
methods.description: Creates a Cord with a sampled method of appending a string of a given size.

methods.name: TestParamToString
methods.description: Converts test parameters to string labels for test naming.

methods.name: InitialOr
methods.description: Determines the initial method identifier based on the size of the Cord.
